posts.title: Update on Koko
posts.description: A few months ago, I blogged about Photos, a potential replacement for Gwenview. The initial feedback (collected here) was a bit rough. posts.title: Help shape the future of desktop icons
posts.description: KDE Plasma has robust support for desktop icons, just like Windows and macOS do. And it’s not going anywhere, either! But over the years, the codebase has gotten a bit crusty.
